card.title: IPhone 6 Plus Boots to recovery mode iTunes Error 9

source.title: IPhone 6 Plus Boots to recovery mode iTunes Error 9

claims.statement: iPhone 6 Plus booting to recovery with error 9 is usually a broken link between the CPU and EEPROM U0301; two resistors under the shield should each read about 0.484 in diode mode.
Repair (very difficult): scrape a small hole in the CPU's bottom-left corner to reach the two lines, jumper them to the resistors, check PP1V8_SDRAM for shorts, and UV-mask.

procedure: Open the shield over the EEPROM resistors.
Scrape into the CPU corner to expose the lines; mask around.
Jumper lines to the resistors; check PP1V8_SDRAM short; mask; restore.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Practice on scrap boards first; scraping into the CPU can easily destroy it.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
